description: Takes the old and the new version of an approval matrix (area, level, approver, limit up to, deputy) and matches the rows by area and level. Returns the critical changes (red: a limit raised by more than 50 percent, a deputy removed, an approver who is their own deputy, an area left without an approver), the other changes (yellow: new approver, moderately raised limit, new or removed approval right), lowered limits and changed deputies for information, who may approve more than before, the questions to answer before the matrix is loaded into the system and the next step. Pass two arrays (old_rows and new_rows) or one array rows with a version column (Old or New; German: Alt or Neu). To check one matrix against the people list use check_approval_matrix. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_rows.description: New version with the same columns.

old_rows.description: Old version: area, level, approver, limit_to, deputy. German column names work too (bereich, stufe, freigeber, limit_bis, vertreter).

rows.description: Alternative to old_rows and new_rows: one list with a version column (Old or New) plus the columns above.

name: compare_approval_matrix
title: Approval matrix old against new: raised limits, new and removed approval rights, lost deputies, areas without an approver
